positions.question: Do you support the regulation of indirect campaign contributions from corporations, unions, and individuals?

evidence.text: Rated 100% by Common Cause
Voted in favor of HR 1: "For the People Act of 2021"

"Congressman Gomez has been a champion of campaign finance reform in the Assembly and Congress. Jimmy was the principal author of the California DISCLOSE Act, which expanded campaign reform and disclosures in California. He supports the overturn of Citizen’s United with the goal of public financing of elections. Jimmy helped pass H.R. 1, the For the People Act, which is the most comprehensive anti-corruption and democracy reform bill to pass the House since Watergate. This legislation will limit the influence of big money in politics, strengthen ethics rules for public servants" and create a small-donor public financing matching system."

positions.question: Do you support protecting government officials, including law enforcement officers, from personal liability in civil lawsuits concerning alleged misconduct?

evidence.text: "Congressman Jimmy Gomez believes ending police brutality and criminal justice reform must be a top priority for Congress. This bill will hold police officers and departments accountable, increase transparency, make structural changes to our justice system, ban chokeholds and eliminate qualified immunity."

"Jimmy is a Cosponsor of the George Floyd Justice in Policing Act. Congressman Gomez believes ending police brutality must be a top priority for Congress. "Jimmy is a cosponsor of a Resolution to Condemn All Acts of Police Brutality with Rep. Ayanna Pressley. This resolution condemns all acts of police brutality, racial profiling, and the use of excessive and militarized force throughout the country."

positions.question: Do you support the federal government increasing funding for affordable housing programs?

evidence.text: "Congressmember Jimmy Gomez is a leader in the fight to build more affordable housing, keep people housed and help people experiencing homelessness get the services they need. In January 2020, Jimmy led a letter with 64 members of congress to call on President-elect Biden and Vice President-elect Kamala Harris to prioritize the housing and homelessness crisis, sign an executive order to halt evictions and work with Congress to pass rental relief."
"Housing is a human right and Jimmy has a long history and voting record to back up his conviction and support for ensuring that everyone has access to affordable housing."

"If Congress is serious about addressing the affordable housing crisis, it must use every tool available in government to build millions of new affordable housing units. As a member of the Ways and Means Committee, Jimmy and his colleagues put forth a proposal that invests in affordable housing through a historic expansion of the Low-Income Housing Tax Credit (LIHTC). This proposal, which was included in the Build Back Better Act, would increase the number of affordable housing units by over 800,000 in the next decade."

"The COVID-19 pandemic has exacerbated our nation’s housing and homelessness crisis. Working families across the U.S. were paying far too much of their income in rent before this crisis and now are facing increasing rents. We cannot afford to, nor should we, turn a blind eye to this problem. That’s why Jimmy has made fighting for more affordable housing, keeping people housed and off the streets a top priority."

positions.question: Do you support the federal government taking action, beyond those of the Federal Reserve, to alleviate inflation?

evidence.text: "At the White House today to celebrate the passage of the historic Inflation Reduction Act! From tackling the climate crisis to slashing health care & energy costs to lowering inflation, this law is for every American."

"Corporation after corporation are reporting record profits as they raise prices on consumer. Why? Because they are using inflation as an excuse. We can’t fight inflation without taking on corporate price gouging. Pass it on."

"Inflation has fallen to its lowest point in over two years! In the face of a global pandemic and Russia’s war on Ukraine that upended supply chains, @housedemocrats and @POTUS moved fast to help Americans feeling the crunch."
Voted in favor of HR 5376 "Inflation Reduction Act of 2022"

positions.question: Do you support the forgiveness of federal student loan debt?

evidence.text: "Jimmy is a cosponsor of the College for All Act, H.R. 2730, which eliminates tuition and fees at four-year public colleges and universities for working families and significantly reduces student debt, and makes community college tuition free for all."
"Jimmy is a cosponsor of the Debt Free College Act to provide students the opportunity to attain a higher education without debt."
"Jimmy supports canceling student loan debt and is a cosponsor of Rep. Ayanna Pressley’s resolution, H.Res.100, calling on President Biden to use executive authority to cancel student loan debt."

"Jimmy’s bill H.R. 1564, the Student Loan Tax Relief Act, which was passed and signed into law as part of the American Rescue Plan Act of 2021, would make any student loan debt forgiveness tax-free and paves the way for student loan debt to be canceled by executive order."

positions.question: Do you support government funding for the development of renewable energy (e.g. solar, wind, geo-thermal)?

Additionally, in Congress, Jimmy helped secure over $300 million to clean up a polluted river in California and sponsored the Climate Solutions Act of 2019 to reduce green gas emissions and transition to a 100 percent renewable energy future by 2035."

"Jimmy is an original cosponsor of the GREEN NEW DEAL by Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez. Jimmy knows that climate change poses an existential threat to our planet and everyone on it. Bold legislative actions are required to reverse the environmental, health and economic damage caused by global warming to communities across the globe before it’s too late, which is what the Green New Deal would provide."

positions.question: Do you support a government-run (e.g. single-payer) healthcare program, such as Medicare-for-All?

evidence.text: "Congressman Jimmy Gomez has been a cosponsor of the Medicare for All Act since he was first elected in 2017, and he is a founding member of the Medicare for All Caucus.
